messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] deployApp error - problems compiling rgl package
parts:
Klaus,

The issue here is that the rgl package can not be compiled because OpenGL is not installed on the base image we use for ShinyApps. ShinyApps does not currently supporting installing additional OS level libraries like (OpenGL). We're looking to add this feature in the coming weeks.

In the mean time, if there is anyway you can remove the dependency from your code, I would suggest you look into that.

I apologize for the inconvenience.

-Andy
